column1: 401976|complete|The uniform finite probability space and every n are specified.|Catalan concatenation changes the uniform law; no subadditivity of the expectations established. Finite component counts do not prove existence of the normalized limit.

401981|complete|Convex body, volume and polar use standard conventions; universal dimension and body scope is explicit.|Simplex equality is a check, not a lower bound for arbitrary bodies. No full-dimensional extremal mechanism; park deep convex geometry.

401988|complete|Dimension, symmetric sets, interpolation parameter and Gaussian measure are specified.|Gaussian log-concavity gives geometric interpolation, weaker than the asserted arithmetic interpolation after the 1/n power. No routine bridge established.

Inspect the primary for the resolved claim and mass conventions; no discovery proposal.

401997|complete|All dimensions n>=4, continuous f,g, and every equatorial orthogonal map are quantified.|For an invertible orthogonal map idempotent means identity, so the non-idempotent condition deserves source checking; replacing it by a non-involution changes scope. No global gluing proof.

402018|incomplete|The construction to be extended and required extra properties are absent.|Existence of some edge-minimal chromatic subgraph is automatic by deletion; it does not extend the intended explicit construction. No wording-only credit.

402019|definition-dependent|Euler tour of a uniform hypergraph needs the source convention, especially tight versus other tours.|For each fixed k the threshold is uniform over all large admissible n; finite tours or an Eulerian auxiliary graph alone do not prove the overlap constraints.

402024|definition-dependent|Clustered colorability omits the uniform bound on monochromatic component size and its parameter dependence.|Must produce a bound depending only on t for every graph excluding the subdivision. Proper-coloring instances cannot supply that uniform mechanism.

402038|complete|The array model and symbol threshold are given; transversal has its standard one-per-row/column distinct-symbol meaning.|All n and adversarial multiplicities matter. A large total number of symbols does not directly bound the largest color class for a local-lemma argument; no valid obstruction yet.

402041|incomplete|The periodic potential and limiting scaling are only referred to by PDF pages.|Every perturbative order above four is required; one additional coefficient would be a helper, not the all-orders disagreement mechanism.

402047|complete|Every finite-dimensional Hopf algebra over an arbitrary field and its trivial-module cohomology are specified.|Known-looking special algebra families cannot justify uniform finite generation. No small algebra with a rigorous non-finite-generation certificate identified.

402050|definition-dependent|Finite type for tensor categories and exact module categories requires the source definitions.|Duality preserving the relevant cohomology finiteness needs a categorical transfer theorem, not finite-dimensionality of individual objects. No short complete chain.

402065|complete|The ambient finite field, dimensions, cardinality381 and exact covering multiplicity are explicit.|Exact cover has Gaussian-binomial(7,2)_2=2667 constraints and 11811 possible 3-spaces. Counting381 is only necessary; no design or infeasibility certificate.

402071|incomplete|The allowed G, coefficient-field setting, completion norm and involution are not given.|Spectrum depends on the completion. Finite representation-ring examples would not settle the asserted general completion; retain without replacement.

402073|definition-dependent|The projective characters xi_nu and characteristic2 modular conventions require definitions.|For every k and every 2-regular partition positivity is required; small staircase decompositions do not control all partitions. No uniform multiplicity mechanism.

402082|complete|After treating the visible escape artifact as typography, finite G, distinct primes and augmentation-one units are explicit.|One implication follows from embedding G into its group ring. The converse needs exclusion of torsion orders across arbitrary finite groups; no full-scope argument.

402083|complete|Finite G, every positive order n and normalized integral units are explicit despite a visible escape artifact.|Group elements give one direction only. Rational-conjugacy failures alone do not establish a spectrum counterexample; no explicit new order mismatch.

402085|definition-dependent|Height-zero character notation and Brauer correspondence rely on standard but unstated block-theoretic definitions.|Uniform n,q,epsilon,ell and every block require a broad character-theoretic theorem; arithmetic exclusions do not make a short finite certificate.

402089|complete|Real elements, class-size2-parts and the conclusion through normal subgroups have standard precise meanings.|The quantifier includes groups with no noncentral real elements. Vacuity is not itself a counterexample; need an actual group violating the normal-series conclusion. No such group constructed.

402129|complete|Triangle variable, variational expression, fixed delta and the whole p regime are explicit.|Must match probability and optimization at relative1+o(1) uniformly along each allowed p sequence; a clique planting supplies only one side.

402130|complete|All bounded degrees, sufficiently large n and every regular input list with correct total degree are explicit.|Packing bounded-degree regular spanning graphs needs a uniform all-list mechanism. Individual factorizations or parity checks do not give the general decomposition.

402141|scope-ambiguous|The asymptotic epsilon range, closeness normalization and meaning of maximal delta at boundary are not fixed.|The phrase lower bounds contrasts with the displayed upper estimate. A construction must give adversarial graphs for every desired exponent, not just a single bad pair.

402143|incomplete|The transition laws and meaning of truly nonlinear are omitted, with corrupted notation.|No definite universal proposition or phase-transition criterion to prove. Retain missing-scope row without substitute.

402148|definition-dependent|Motivic weight and weight multiplicities require automorphic archimedean conventions.|Classification over variable rank requires global spectral restrictions; a finite list of examples cannot prove exhaustion.

402157|scope-ambiguous|The topology and base component of Emb(A,X) are unstated; pi1 depends on a basepoint/component.|Simple-real discriminant complements in a linear system depend on X and A; a genus0 calculation would not classify arbitrary curves.

402158|incomplete|Neither refined invariant, reference10, surface class nor sufficiently ample scope is supplied.|No equality can be technically checked from this literal. Need exact enumerative definitions and coefficient ring before comparisons.

402203|complete|Unital commutative rings, polynomial regularity in every positive variable count and finite-type-over-field scope are given.|A proof uniform in arbitrary characteristic is needed; characteristic0 or perfect-field theorems cannot be extrapolated without checking hypotheses.

402237|scope-ambiguous|Nonlinear instability has no topology, solution class or inverse-derivative mean convention.|A linear unstable mode is insufficient for the nonlinear assertion near a peaked wave. Requires well-posedness and norm-specific growth control.

402242|scope-ambiguous|All alpha>1/2 and H^(alpha/2) data are given but the solution/uniqueness notion is unspecified.|Subcritical scaling and conservation do not alone provide local well-posedness at this regularity; no complete uniform analytic route.

402246|definition-dependent|Cube regularity and mean-curvature/dihedral conventions must be specified in the source.|Every metric in dimensions3 through7 is at issue. Scalar curvature inequalities do not yield a finite corner certificate or a short rigidity proof.

402256|incomplete|Dimension m range, flow setup, initial data and boundary/asymptotic conditions are absent.|One lower metric bound can imply completeness under appropriate hypotheses, but reversing it for every nonsymmetric flow needs missing analytic data.

402276|incomplete|Base-field hypotheses, kw,jw,completion and Adams-operation parameter g are undefined; k is overloaded.|Two assertions are conjoined: an operation formula and a spectrum equivalence. Verifying coefficients alone would not settle the spectrum-level statement.

402290|definition-dependent|Ultrapower and B_infinity conventions, including the quotient ideal, are unstated.|The title already calls this Theorem4. Even a successful CH back-and-forth reconstruction would be a known-proof candidate, not cleared novelty.

402292|definition-dependent|LAff(T(A))++ and dimension-function conventions are needed, including empty-trace behavior.|All strictly positive lower-semicontinuous affine functions must be realized in the stabilized algebra. Real-rank or regularity special cases do not give the universal result.

402305|definition-dependent|Centrally symmetric neighborliness needs the no-antipodal-pair convention.|All d>=4 and n>=d require a uniform sphere construction; polytopal obstruction is not an obstruction for arbitrary simplicial spheres.

402317|scope-ambiguous|Ambient versus intrinsic normalized volume is not distinguished for lower-dimensional lattice polytopes.|All sufficiently large integer dilates, not just multiples of one dilation, must work. A divisibility subsequence is not full scope; selected primary passage needed.

402325|definition-dependent|Coefficient field and the Orlik-Solomon representation conventions are unstated.|Dimension log-concavity does not imply containment characterwise; need positivity in the representation ring for every finite symmetry group.

402339|scope-ambiguous|Local spin algebra and path/gap regularity conventions are implicit; detection is open-ended rather than an iff criterion.|An invariant constant along all allowed smooth gapped paths could distinguish examples, but examples alone do not classify all phases. No complete invariant built.

402344|scope-ambiguous|The literal range1<p<1+d/2 may include energy-unbounded regimes; admissible finite-energy density operators are implicit.|Scaling compares kinetic L^2 versus nonlinear L^(d(p-1)); a range/domain discrepancy would be a correction, not discovery credit. Need primary conventions before any claimed counterexample.

402371|definition-dependent|Wild Weil-representation class, Herbrand function and Carayol type require source definitions.|Both implications under twist-minimality are required. Plot symmetry for selected conductors is not a characterization theorem.

402374|incomplete|The geometric multiplicity m_geom and admissible spherical-pair/character conditions are omitted.|An arbitrary pair requires a trace-formula comparison. Familiar multiplicity-one examples do not imply this universal formula.

402379|incomplete|X,S(X),W and transforms Phi_w are undefined in the literal.|Bounded support after all transforms might describe a precise Schwartz space only after local-field and normalization choices; cannot assess equality here.

402457|complete|Prime sequence, absolute-difference recursion and every row r>=2 are explicit.|Checking many rows only verifies a prefix; no induction invariant controls newly introduced primes for every depth. Park without another finite sweep.
